name: Caladria Chronicles Volume 2
source:
After the Otori twins, Tsubasa and Shou, end up getting kidnapped by some Nephrine forces, that’s when their plan is starting to surface. Things get even more intense as other Caladrians, like Nerisu’s group and the princess of Tamarin, Tokino Miyanohara, get involved.

[From [url=https://starlightvisual.itch.io/caladria-chronicles-volume-2]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在Otori双胞胎Tsubasa和Shou最终被一些Nephrine势力绑架后，他们的计划开始浮出水面。随着其他卡拉德里亚人（例如奈里斯的团队和狨猴公主宫之原时乃）的介入，事情变得更加激烈。

[来自[url=https://starlightvisual.itch.io/caladria-chronicles-volume-2]Itch.io[/url]]
